answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 1796 Country: India Title: What is the meaning of name 'Urooj Fatima'? Question: What is the meaning of name 'Urooj Fatima'? Answer ID: 1796 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 547/569=M) ?Urooj Fatima? means ?progress of Fatima ?. Urooj means: progress, while the name of the youngest daughter of the Prophet (Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) was Fatima Zahra. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
